_comment: SYNTHETIC fixture for UI development. Not a benchmark result.

groups.label: Loop
groups.description: Share of runs where the same tool call (same tool and arguments hash, or the same command text for shell tools) repeats 3 or more times in a row, or 4 or more times with no edit tool call between, over runs with gateway or agent_stream events; an observed pattern, not a root cause.

groups.label: Unverified finish
groups.description: Share of runs that end with a success claim and no shell command containing pytest, py.test, python -m pytest, unittest, npm test, go test or make test (or a tool named for tests) after the last edit tool call, over runs with gateway or agent_stream events and a known claim; an observed pattern, not a root cause.

groups.label: Ignored error
groups.description: Share of runs that claim success after a failed tool result (an error flag or a non-zero exit) that none of the next 2 tool calls answers with a retry of the same call or target, an edit, or a read of a file the failed call named, over runs with agent_stream events and a known claim; an observed pattern, not a root cause.

groups.label: False completion
groups.description: Share of runs that claimed success while the hidden verifier failed, over runs whose verifier failed and whose claim is known.
